coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth variables (45%): ZB-2p versus profiled theoretical scheduling, ideal communication overlap, computed versus actual timelines, bubble rate, and execution alignment.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the fixed 14.6B/46-layer model with 7B/13B models, varies pipeline size instead of fixing 16 stages, and varies microbatch counts instead of fixing 64. Does not preserve ENABLE_ZERO_BUBBLE=1 and ZERO_BUBBLE_MEM_LIMIT=32. Profiling only partially matches: Nsight and exports are included, but custom Python extraction and SVG visualization are missing. Throughput is reported in tokens/s rather than samples/s/GPU. Adds unrelated experimental factors and metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that ZB-2p should achieve near-zero bubbles, typically below 1%, with minor practical overheads and validation through high throughput and close theoretical-to-profiled timeline alignment.
